claims: Aunt Gladys is the main antagonist in the 2025 horror film Weapons.
Aunt Gladys is portrayed by Amy Madigan.
Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress at the 2026 Academy Awards for the role.
Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress at the 2026 SAG Awards for the role.
Director Zach Cregger created the character Aunt Gladys to represent the chaos of addiction.
The film Weapons grossed over $270 million worldwide.
Aunt Gladys is a parasitic witch.
Aunt Gladys uses voodoo rituals to drain life force.
Aunt Gladys is responsible for disappearing children.
The character Aunt Gladys is known for her ghoulish makeup, red wig, and tinted sunglasses.
Aunt Gladys is visually defined by a bright red wig.
Aunt Gladys is visually defined by oversized tinted sunglasses.
Aunt Gladys is visually defined by heavily stylized, deteriorating makeup.
